classification: The 0.4.17 recovery succeeded for the core OS: lazy MSC removed the boot-time DMA allocation failure, transient DSI refresh timeouts preserved the backlight and retried, microSD and its dynamic catalog became ready, and the externally powered hub took the intended full-speed route. The attached low-speed child consistently failed its first short descriptor transfer, and espressif/usb 1.5.0 then disabled downstream port 2 because its hidden default permits only one reset attempt.
corrective_action: Keep the pinned official USB source and full-speed root policy. Expose the existing bounded downstream retry integer only for the Waveshare controller profile, use three attempts with a 500 ms downstream reset-recovery interval, require those exact values in the release verifier, and issue a new exact-artifact authorization before testing again.
